rules.title: Whole test suite as the edit loop

estimate.assumption: affected-only or last-failed runs cost about 20-40% of a full run

rules.why: A full suite after each edit multiplies wait time and output tokens.
rules.fix: Run changed/related tests while iterating (--changed, --related, -run, --last-failed, jest --onlyFailures) and the full suite once before finishing.
rules.after: npx vitest related src/changed.ts   # full suite once at the end

rules.title: Playwright suite fully rerun

estimate.assumption: rerunning only failures or one spec costs about 10-30% of the full run

rules.why: Browser suites are the slowest feedback loop; full reruns after a one-spec fix are mostly waste.
rules.fix: Use --last-failed, a single spec/line, one --project, and --workers sized to cores; full run once in CI.

rules.title: CI/deploy status polled with sleep loops

estimate.assumption: each avoided poll saves its model turn (tokens) and on average about half the poll interval of overshoot; a blocking watch ends exactly when CI ends

rules.why: Every poll is a full model turn (context re-read, tokens) plus a sleep overshoot.
rules.fix: Block in one call: gh run watch --exit-status, or gh pr checks --watch --fail-fast.
rules.source: GitHub CLI manual, gh run watch and gh pr checks: https://cli.github.com/manual/gh_run_watch

rules.title: Formatter run by hand after edits

estimate.assumption: a PostToolUse hook formats each edited file without a model turn; each avoided call saves its turn (about 8 s and one turn of tokens); the formatter's own time stays

rules.why: Each formatter call is a model turn that re-reads the context, and the agent can forget it. A hook runs it after every Edit or Write.
rules.fix: Run the formatter from a PostToolUse hook on Edit|Write in .claude/settings.json instead of by hand.
rules.source: Claude Code docs, Best practices (formatter as a PostToolUse hook): https://code.claude.com/docs/en/best-practices
rules.before: npx prettier --write src/a.ts   # after each edit
rules.after: PostToolUse hook, matcher Edit|Write: npx prettier --write --ignore-unknown <edited file>

rules.title: Large repositories cloned repeatedly

estimate.assumption: shallow/partial clone or `git worktree add` from an existing clone transfers a small fraction of history

rules.why: Full clones re-download history and blobs that already exist locally.
rules.fix: Clone once, then `git worktree add` or `git fetch`; use --depth 1 --filter=blob:none for throwaway copies.
rules.after: git clone --depth 1 --filter=blob:none https://host/org/repo.git   # or: git worktree add

rules.title: Recursive grep/find instead of rg/fd

estimate.assumption: rg respects .gitignore and skips node_modules/.git, so it is usually several times faster and prints far less noise

rules.why: Recursive grep/find walk dependency folders and build output and return noisy matches.
rules.fix: Use rg/fd (or the built-in Grep/Glob tools), which honour .gitignore.
